summary: The audit checks the 30 units: CSRE 100 and one Minor Core course (JEWISHST 77, 115 or 117), each letter graded with a C- or better, and electives from JEWISHST courses plus up to 5 units of AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CHILATST, CSRE or NATIVEAM courses, passed with a D- or better. Checked by hand: petitioned courses (up to 5 units), external credit (up to 10 units) and that no more than one class is taken S/NC.

Q65Ritx4.why: "Jewish Studies minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in Jewish Studies, with the exception below. Jewish Studies minors may count up to 5 units of Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Comparative Studies in Race and Ethnicity (CSRE), or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) courses" (DAAAS courses are AFRICAAM). Policies: "No more than 5 units of petitioned courses that are not listed under CCSRE or cross-listed with CCSRE may be applied to electives"; those and external credit (up to ten units) are moved in by hand.

NegCns0D.why: Grading: "A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Minor Core. ... Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units." A CR or S is not a C- and S/NC is allowed only in the additional units, so the core courses are letter graded.
